source: the verifier's own held-out FineWeb validation shards, data/fineweb10B/fineweb_val_*.bin
note: Frozen partition of the verifier's held-out split into four disjoint folds by half-open token range over the concatenated validation stream. This file declares the partition so the sustain rule is legible from the agent surface; it carries none of the split's bytes and resolves no path to them. The order in which the verifier evaluates the folds is scheduled by the verifier and is not announced.
_fold_tokens_note: RE-SCALED, wave-4. The partition previously declared four folds of 2097152 tokens each. The verifier evaluates every fold for the submission, for the delivered baseline and for the reference floor, which is twelve fold passes plus three whole-window passes over the graded window, and at the old fold width that measured past the grading timeout. The partition keeps its four disjoint folds and its schedules; only the width moved, and the width is a verifier-owned quantity that no submission can reach.
